name: Flag Home Workspace Conflict
summary: Blocks registration completion when duplicate home workspaces or invalid owner membership cannot be reconciled safely.

preconditions.expression: durable-identity == resolved and home-workspace in [required,creating] and (existing-home-workspace-count > 1 or home-owner-membership-invalid == true)

setup: Create duplicate home-workspace candidates or an ownership relationship that violates the home-workspace invariant.

postconditions.expression: home-workspace == conflict and workspace-membership == conflict and current-workspace == invalid and session-capability == blocked
